The returned string may start and/or end with incomplete Unicode code points in case the current read position and/or the last read character (code unit) is in the middle of a code point. The current position is advanced accordingly. If the end of the file is reached, the number of returned characters can be less than the requested number, and the current position is set to the end of the file. In case of an error, the current position is not changed.
